payload.default: Both commands use optimistic locking on job row version. First commit wins, second sees stale version and retries with fresh state. If stop commits first, wind-back sees CANCELLED state and fails ('cannot wind back cancelled job'). If wind-back commits first, stop sees rewound state and succeeds, setting stop_requested. No partial state observable; each command is atomic.
payload.text: What bad outcomes are possible if operator runs `vibey stop <job-id>` and `vibey wind-back <job-id> 5` simultaneously on the same job, and how should the system resolve it?
